counterfactual_missing_items: bile duct communication is not assessed
decisive_items: mucinous cystadenocarcinoma or sarcoma of the liver was made
a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor
response.rationale: R1 best integrates the multilocular cystic liver mass, enhancing solid component, hemorrhage, and elevated CA125/DUPAN-2 with the explicit preoperative diagnosis. R4 only restates the differential phrase without independent imaging or marker support, and R2 is not in the liver differential; DUPAN-2 is nonspecific.

rejected.why: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm lacks liver-specific multilocular/solid/hemorrhagic features and bile duct communication is not described; DUPAN-2 elevation is nonspecific.
